        [DllImport("user32.dll")]
        private static extern bool SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(int dpiContext);
        private static readonly int DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT_PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2 = -4;

        [DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Auto)]
        private static extern IntPtr SendMessage(IntPtr hWnd, int msg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam);
        private const int EM_SETMARGINS = 0xD3;
        private const int EC_LEFTMARGIN = 0x1;

        private const string DefaultGamePath = @"C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Motor Town\MotorTown\Content\Paks";
        private const string ConfigFileName = "config.json";
        private readonly string serverStorageDir = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "ServerMods");
        private readonly string settingsFilePath;
        private readonly string backupStorageDir;
        private readonly string saveGameBackupDir;
        private string customEngineIniPath = null;

        private TextBox txtGamePath;
        private ComboBox cboServerDropdown;
        private TextBox txtServerSearchBox;
        private ComboBox cboThemeSelector;
        private TextBox txtModSearchBox;

        private readonly Color TextMuted = Color.FromArgb(180, 185, 195);

        [STAThread]
        public static void Main()
        {
            try
            {
                try { SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT_PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2); } catch { }

                Application.EnableVisualStyles();
                Application.SetCompatibleTextRenderingDefault(false);
                Application.Run(new ModManagerForm());
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Fatal Startup Error: " + ex.ToString(), "Launch Failed", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
            }
        }

        public ModManagerForm()
        {
            SetStyle(ControlStyles.AllPaintingInWmPaint | ControlStyles.UserPaint | ControlStyles.OptimizedDoubleBuffer, true);

            Text = "MotorTown: Behind The Wheel - Mod Manager";
            Width = 560;
            Height = 1130;
            MinimumSize = new Size(560, 1130);

            FormBorderStyle = FormBorderStyle.Sizable;
            MaximizeBox = true;
            StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterScreen;

            backupStorageDir = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, "Backup_Vanilla");
            saveGameBackupDir = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, "Backup_Saves");
            settingsFilePath = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, "settings.txt");

            EnsureStorageDirectoryExists();
            InitializeComponentLayout();
            
            // 1. Load saved configurations FIRST so it reads the saved theme from disk
            LoadCheckboxSettings();

            // 2. Fall back to defaults only if no selection was loaded from settings
            if (cboThemeSelector.SelectedIndex == -1)
            {
                cboThemeSelector.SelectedIndex = 0; 
            }
            if (cboEditorSelector.SelectedIndex == -1)
            {
                cboEditorSelector.SelectedIndex = 0;
            }

            LoadInitialPath();
            RefreshServerList();
        }

        private string GetEffectiveEngineIniPath()
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(customEngineIniPath) && File.Exists(customEngineIniPath))
            {
                return customEngineIniPath;
            }

            string defaultPath = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), @"MotorTown\Saved\Config\Windows\Engine.ini");
            if (File.Exists(defaultPath))
            {
                return defaultPath;
            }

            return defaultPath;
        }

        private bool EnsureEngineIniExists(out string targetPath)
        {
            targetPath = GetEffectiveEngineIniPath();

            if (File.Exists(targetPath))
            {
                return true;
            }

            DialogResult result = MessageBox.Show(
                "Could not locate 'Engine.ini' automatically.\n\nWould you like to browse and locate your 'Engine.ini' file manually?",
                "Engine.ini Not Found",
                MessageBoxButtons.YesNo,
                MessageBoxIcon.Warning);

            if (result == DialogResult.Yes)
            {
                using (OpenFileDialog ofd = new OpenFileDialog())
                {
                    ofd.Title = "Select Engine.ini File";
                    ofd.Filter = "INI Configuration Files (*.ini)|*.ini|All Files (*.*)|*.*";
                    ofd.FileName = "Engine.ini";

                    if (ofd.ShowDialog(this) == DialogResult.OK)
                    {
                        customEngineIniPath = ofd.FileName;
                        SaveCheckboxSettings();
                        targetPath = customEngineIniPath;
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private void EnsureStorageDirectoryExists()
        {
            try
            {
                if (!Directory.Exists(serverStorageDir))
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(serverStorageDir);
                if (!Directory.Exists(backupStorageDir))
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(backupStorageDir);
                if (!Directory.Exists(saveGameBackupDir))
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(saveGameBackupDir);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Initializing Storage Directory", ex);
            }
        }

        private void LoadCheckboxSettings()
        {
            try
            {
                if (File.Exists(settingsFilePath))
                {
                    string[] lines = File.ReadAllLines(settingsFilePath);
                    foreach (string line in lines)
                    {
                        if (line.StartsWith("SmartMatching=", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            bool val;
                            if (bool.TryParse(line.Substring(13).Trim(), out val))
                                chkSmartMatching.Checked = val;
                        }
                        else if (line.StartsWith("AutoEngineIni=", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            bool val;
                            if (bool.TryParse(line.Substring(14).Trim(), out val))
                                chkAutoEngineIni.Checked = val;
                        }
                        else if (line.StartsWith("Theme=", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            string theme = line.Substring(6).Trim();
                            for (int i = 0; i < cboThemeSelector.Items.Count; i++)
                            {
                                if (cboThemeSelector.Items[i].ToString().Equals(theme, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                                {
                                    cboThemeSelector.SelectedIndex = i;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        else if (line.StartsWith("PreferredEditor=", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            string editor = line.Substring(16).Trim();
                            for (int i = 0; i < cboEditorSelector.Items.Count; i++)
                            {
                                if (cboEditorSelector.Items[i].ToString().Equals(editor, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                                {
                                    cboEditorSelector.SelectedIndex = i;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        else if (line.StartsWith("EngineIniPath=", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            string path = line.Substring(14).Trim();
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
                            {
                                customEngineIniPath = path;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch { }
        }

        private void SaveCheckboxSettings()
        {
            try
            {
                string themeName = (cboThemeSelector.SelectedItem != null) ? cboThemeSelector.SelectedItem.ToString() : "Dark Mode";
                string editorName = (cboEditorSelector.SelectedItem != null) ? cboEditorSelector.SelectedItem.ToString() : "Windows Notepad";
                string iniPathEntry = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(customEngineIniPath) ? customEngineIniPath : "";
                
                string content = "SmartMatching=" + chkSmartMatching.Checked.ToString() + "\n" +
                                 "AutoEngineIni=" + chkAutoEngineIni.Checked.ToString() + "\n" +
                                 "Theme=" + themeName + "\n" +
                                 "PreferredEditor=" + editorName + "\n" +
                                 "EngineIniPath=" + iniPathEntry + "\n";
                File.WriteAllText(settingsFilePath, content);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Saving Checkbox Settings", ex);
            }
        }

        private void UpdateOpenEngineIniButtonText()
        {
            string editor = (cboEditorSelector.SelectedItem != null) ? cboEditorSelector.SelectedItem.ToString() : "Windows Notepad";
            btnOpenEngineIni.Text = "Open Engine.ini in " + editor;
        }

        private void AttachSearchIcon(TextBox textBox)
        {
            PictureBox iconBox = new PictureBox
            {
                Size = new Size(16, 16),
                Location = new Point(3, 2),
                Cursor = Cursors.IBeam,
                BackColor = Color.Transparent
            };

            iconBox.Paint += delegate(object s, PaintEventArgs pe)
            {
                pe.Graphics.SmoothingMode = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
                Color color = (cboThemeSelector.SelectedItem != null && cboThemeSelector.SelectedItem.ToString() == "Light Mode") 
                    ? Color.Gray 
                    : AccentOrange;

                using (Pen pen = new Pen(color, 1.8f))
                {
                    pe.Graphics.DrawEllipse(pen, 1, 1, 8, 8);
                    pe.Graphics.DrawLine(pen, 8, 8, 13, 13);
                }
            };

            iconBox.Click += delegate(object s, EventArgs e) { textBox.Focus(); };

            Panel paddingPanel = new Panel
            {
                Size = new Size(20, textBox.ClientSize.Height),
                Dock = DockStyle.Left,
                BackColor = Color.Transparent
            };
            paddingPanel.Controls.Add(iconBox);
            textBox.Controls.Add(paddingPanel);

            SendMessage(textBox.Handle, EM_SETMARGINS, (IntPtr)EC_LEFTMARGIN, (IntPtr)(20 & 0xFFFF));
        }

        private void ApplyTheme(string themeName)
        {
            bool isLight = (themeName == "Light Mode");

            BackgroundImage = null;
            BackColor = isLight ? SystemColors.Control : ThemeDarkBg;

            Color lblColor = isLight ? SystemColors.ControlText : AccentYellow;
            Color txtBg = isLight ? SystemColors.Window : ThemeControlDark;
            Color txtFg = isLight ? SystemColors.WindowText : TextLight;
            Color btnBg = isLight ? SystemColors.ControlLight : ThemeControlDark;
            Color btnFg = isLight ? SystemColors.ControlText : TextLight;

            lblPathHeader.ForeColor = lblColor;
            lblServerHeader.ForeColor = lblColor;
            lblThemeHeader.ForeColor = lblColor;
            lblModSearchHeader.ForeColor = lblColor;
            lblEditorHeader.ForeColor = lblColor;
            lblPathHeader.BackColor = Color.Transparent;
            lblServerHeader.BackColor = Color.Transparent;
            lblThemeHeader.BackColor = Color.Transparent;
            lblModSearchHeader.BackColor = Color.Transparent;
            lblEditorHeader.BackColor = Color.Transparent;

            foreach (var ctrl in new Control[] { txtGamePath, txtServerSearchBox, cboServerDropdown, cboThemeSelector, cboEditorSelector, txtModSearchBox, lstServerPaks })
            {
                ctrl.BackColor = txtBg;
                ctrl.ForeColor = txtFg;
            }

            foreach (var btn in new Button[] { btnBrowsePath, btnOpenDirectory, btnAddServerFolder, btnBackupPaks, btnRestoreBackup, btnBackupSaves, btnManageSaves })
            {
                btn.BackColor = btnBg;
                btn.ForeColor = btnFg;
                btn.FlatStyle = isLight ? FlatStyle.Standard : FlatStyle.Flat;
                if (!isLight) btn.FlatAppearance.BorderColor = AccentOrange;
            }

            btnDeleteServerFolder.BackColor = isLight ? SystemColors.ControlLight : Color.FromArgb(160, 35, 35);
            btnDeleteServerFolder.ForeColor = btnFg;
            btnDeleteServerFolder.FlatStyle = isLight ? FlatStyle.Standard : FlatStyle.Flat;
            if (!isLight) { btnDeleteServerFolder.FlatAppearance.BorderColor = Color.Red; }

            btnDeleteSelectedPak.BackColor = isLight ? SystemColors.ControlLight : Color.FromArgb(160, 35, 35);
            btnDeleteSelectedPak.ForeColor = btnFg;
            btnDeleteSelectedPak.FlatStyle = isLight ? FlatStyle.Standard : FlatStyle.Flat;
            if (!isLight) { btnDeleteSelectedPak.FlatAppearance.BorderColor = Color.Red; }

            btnMergeServerMods.BackColor = isLight ? SystemColors.ControlLight : ThemeControlDark;
            btnMergeServerMods.ForeColor = btnFg;
            btnMergeServerMods.FlatStyle = isLight ? FlatStyle.Standard : FlatStyle.Flat;
            if (!isLight) { btnMergeServerMods.FlatAppearance.BorderColor = AccentOrange; }

            btnDeployMods.BackColor = isLight ? SystemColors.ControlLight : AccentOrange;
            btnDeployMods.ForeColor = isLight ? SystemColors.ControlText : Color.Black;
            btnDeployMods.FlatStyle = isLight ? FlatStyle.Standard : FlatStyle.Flat;
            if (!isLight) { btnDeployMods.FlatAppearance.BorderColor = AccentYellow; }

            btnRevertVanilla.BackColor = isLight ? SystemColors.ControlLight : Color.FromArgb(180, 80, 20);
            btnRevertVanilla.ForeColor = btnFg;
            btnRevertVanilla.FlatStyle = isLight ? FlatStyle.Standard : FlatStyle.Flat;
            if (!isLight) { btnRevertVanilla.FlatAppearance.BorderColor = AccentOrange; }

            btnOpenEngineIni.BackColor = isLight ? SystemColors.ControlLight : ThemeControlDark;
            btnOpenEngineIni.ForeColor = btnFg;
            btnOpenEngineIni.FlatStyle = isLight ? FlatStyle.Standard : FlatStyle.Flat;
            if (!isLight) { btnOpenEngineIni.FlatAppearance.BorderColor = AccentOrange; }

            btnLaunchGame.BackColor = isLight ? SystemColors.ControlLight : Color.FromArgb(40, 140, 60);
            btnLaunchGame.ForeColor = btnFg;
            btnLaunchGame.FlatStyle = isLight ? FlatStyle.Standard : FlatStyle.Flat;
            if (!isLight) { btnLaunchGame.FlatAppearance.BorderColor = Color.FromArgb(60, 180, 80); }

            chkSmartMatching.ForeColor = txtFg;
            chkSmartMatching.BackColor = Color.Transparent;

            chkAutoEngineIni.ForeColor = txtFg;
            chkAutoEngineIni.BackColor = Color.Transparent;

            pnlDropTarget.BackColor = txtBg;
            lblDropInstruction.ForeColor = isLight ? SystemColors.GrayText : TextMuted;

            txtServerSearchBox.Invalidate();
            txtModSearchBox.Invalidate();
        }

        private void ShowError(string context, Exception ex)
        {
            MessageBox.Show("An error occurred while " + context + ".\n\nTechnical Details: " + ex.Message, "Mod Manager Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
        }

        private void OnCheckboxSettingChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            UpdateDropInstructionText();
            SaveCheckboxSettings();
        }

        private void UpdateDropInstructionText()
        {
            string matchingPart = chkSmartMatching.Checked ? "Auto-extracts Paks, Reads Readmes" : "Auto-extracts Paks";
            string iniPart = chkAutoEngineIni.Checked ? " & Smart-Merges Engine.ini" : "";
            
            lblDropInstruction.Text = "Drag and Drop .pak, .zip or ReadMe Files Here\n\n(" + matchingPart + iniPart + ")";
        }

        private void LoadInitialPath()
        {
            if (File.Exists(ConfigFileName))
            {
                try
                {
                    string json = File.ReadAllText(ConfigFileName);
                    if (json.Contains("\"target_path\":"))
                    {
                        int start = json.IndexOf("\"target_path\":") + 14;
                        int firstQuote = json.IndexOf("\"", start);
                        int secondQuote = json.IndexOf("\"", firstQuote + 1);
                        if (firstQuote != -1 && secondQuote != -1)
                        {
                            txtGamePath.Text = json.Substring(firstQuote + 1, secondQuote - firstQuote - 1).Replace("\\\\", "\\");
                            return;
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch { }
            }
            txtGamePath.Text = DefaultGamePath;
        }

        private void PersistConfigPath(string path)
        {
            try
            {
                string json = "{\"target_path\":\"" + path.Replace("\\", "\\\\") + "\"}";
                File.WriteAllText(ConfigFileName, json);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Saving Configuration Settings", ex);
            }
        }

        private void OnBrowsePathClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            using (FolderBrowserDialog dialog = new FolderBrowserDialog())
            {
                if (dialog.ShowDialog() == DialogResult.OK)
                {
                    txtGamePath.Text = dialog.SelectedPath;
                    PersistConfigPath(dialog.SelectedPath);
                }
            }
        }

        private void OnOpenDirectoryClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string path = txtGamePath.Text;
            if (Directory.Exists(path))
            {
                try { Process.Start("explorer.exe", path); }
                catch (Exception ex) { ShowError("Opening Game Directory in Windows Explorer", ex); }
            }
            else
            {
                MessageBox.Show("The specified folder directory does not exist.", "Folder Not Found", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
            }
        }

        private void RefreshServerList()
        {
            try
            {
                cachedServerFolders.Clear();
                cboServerDropdown.Items.Clear();

                foreach (var dir in Directory.GetDirectories(serverStorageDir))
                {
                    string folderName = Path.GetFileName(dir);
                    if (!folderName.Equals("Backup_Vanilla", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                        !folderName.Equals("Backup_Saves", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                        !folderName.Equals("Backup_CharacterSaves", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        cachedServerFolders.Add(folderName);
                    }
                }

                FilterServers(txtServerSearchBox.Text);

                if (cboServerDropdown.Items.Count > 0)
                    cboServerDropdown.SelectedIndex = 0;
                else
                    LoadSelectedServerPaks();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Loading Server Folders List", ex);
            }
        }

        private void OnServerSearchChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            FilterServers(txtServerSearchBox.Text);
            if (cboServerDropdown.Items.Count > 0)
                cboServerDropdown.SelectedIndex = 0;
            else
                LoadSelectedServerPaks();
        }

        private void FilterServers(string query)
        {
            cboServerDropdown.Items.Clear();
            foreach (string server in cachedServerFolders)
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query) || server.IndexOf(query, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                {
                    cboServerDropdown.Items.Add(server);
                }
            }
        }

        private void LoadSelectedServerPaks()
        {
            try
            {
                cachedServerPaks.Clear();
                string serverName = (cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem != null) ? cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem.ToString() : null;

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(serverName))
                {
                    string targetDir = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, serverName);
                    if (Directory.Exists(targetDir))
                    {
                        foreach (string file in Directory.GetFiles(targetDir, "*.pak"))
                        {
                            cachedServerPaks.Add(Path.GetFileName(file));
                        }
                    }
                }

                FilterMods(txtModSearchBox.Text);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Listing Mod Files for Selected Server", ex);
            }
        }

        private void OnModSearchChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            FilterMods(txtModSearchBox.Text);
        }

        private void FilterMods(string query)
        {
            lstServerPaks.Items.Clear();
            foreach (string pak in cachedServerPaks)
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query) || pak.IndexOf(query, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                {
                    lstServerPaks.Items.Add(pak);
                }
            }
        }

        private void OnAddServerClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string name = Interaction.InputBox("Enter the new server folder name:", "Add Server", "");
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name))
            {
                try
                {
                    string trimmedName = name.Trim();
                    if (trimmedName.Equals("Backup_Vanilla", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                        trimmedName.Equals("Backup_Saves", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                        trimmedName.Equals("Backup_CharacterSaves", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        MessageBox.Show("That name is reserved for system backups.", "Invalid Name", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
                        return;
                    }

                    Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, trimmedName));
                    txtServerSearchBox.Text = "";
                    RefreshServerList();
                    cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem = trimmedName;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    ShowError("Creating New Server Folder", ex);
                }
            }
        }

        private void OnDeleteServerClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string serverName = (cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem != null) ? cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem.ToString() : "";
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(serverName))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Please select a server folder to delete.", "Notice");
                return;
            }

            string serverDirPath = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, serverName);

            if (MessageBox.Show("Are you sure you want to delete the entire server folder '" + serverName + "' and all its stored mod paks?", "Confirm Delete Server", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Warning) == DialogResult.Yes)
            {
                try
                {
                    if (Directory.Exists(serverDirPath))
                    {
                        Directory.Delete(serverDirPath, true);
                        RefreshServerList();
                        MessageBox.Show("Successfully deleted server folder '" + serverName + "'.", "Success");
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    ShowError("Deleting Server Folder", ex);
                }
            }
        }

        private void OnDeleteModClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            if (lstServerPaks.SelectedItem == null)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Please select a .pak file from the list to delete.", "Notice");
                return;
            }

            string serverName = (cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem != null) ? cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem.ToString() : "";
            string fileName = lstServerPaks.SelectedItem.ToString();
            string filePath = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, serverName, fileName);

            if (MessageBox.Show("Are you sure you want to delete '" + fileName + "'?", "Confirm Delete", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Warning) == DialogResult.Yes)
            {
                try
                {
                    if (File.Exists(filePath))
                    {
                        File.Delete(filePath);
                        LoadSelectedServerPaks();
                        MessageBox.Show("Successfully deleted '" + fileName + "'.", "Success");
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    ShowError("Deleting Selected Mod File", ex);
                }
            }
        }

        private void OnMergeServerModsClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            if (cachedServerFolders.Count < 2)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("You need at least two server folders to perform a merge.", "Insufficient Servers", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
                return;
            }

            Form mergeForm = new Form
            {
                Text = "Merge Server Mods",
                Width = 720,
                Height = 560,
                StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent,
                MinimizeBox = false,
                MaximizeBox = false
            };

            Label lblServer1 = new Label { Text = "First Server:", Location = new Point(15, 15), AutoSize = true, Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 9, FontStyle.Bold) };
            ComboBox cboServer1 = new ComboBox { Location = new Point(115, 12), Width = 210, DropDownStyle = ComboBoxStyle.DropDownList };
            
            Label lblServer2 = new Label { Text = "Second Server:", Location = new Point(355, 15), AutoSize = true, Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 9, FontStyle.Bold) };
            ComboBox cboServer2 = new ComboBox { Location = new Point(475, 12), Width = 210, DropDownStyle = ComboBoxStyle.DropDownList };

            foreach (string s in cachedServerFolders)
            {
                cboServer1.Items.Add(s);
                cboServer2.Items.Add(s);
            }

            if (cboServer1.Items.Count > 0) cboServer1.SelectedIndex = 0;
            if (cboServer2.Items.Count > 1) cboServer2.SelectedIndex = 1;
            else if (cboServer2.Items.Count > 0) cboServer2.SelectedIndex = 0;

            CheckedListBox chkListLeft = new CheckedListBox { Location = new Point(15, 50), Size = new Size(320, 380), CheckOnClick = true, Anchor = AnchorStyles.Top | AnchorStyles.Bottom | AnchorStyles.Left };
            CheckedListBox chkListRight = new CheckedListBox { Location = new Point(365, 50), Size = new Size(320, 380), CheckOnClick = true, Anchor = AnchorStyles.Top | AnchorStyles.Bottom | AnchorStyles.Right };

            Action loadLeftPaks = delegate
            {
                chkListLeft.Items.Clear();
                string sName = cboServer1.SelectedItem as string;
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sName))
                {
                    string dir = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, sName);
                    if (Directory.Exists(dir))
                    {
                        foreach (string f in Directory.GetFiles(dir, "*.pak"))
                        {
                            chkListLeft.Items.Add(Path.GetFileName(f), true);
                        }
                    }
                }
            };

            Action loadRightPaks = delegate
            {
                chkListRight.Items.Clear();
                string sName = cboServer2.SelectedItem as string;
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sName))
                {
                    string dir = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, sName);
                    if (Directory.Exists(dir))
                    {
                        foreach (string f in Directory.GetFiles(dir, "*.pak"))
                        {
                            chkListRight.Items.Add(Path.GetFileName(f), true);
                        }
                    }
                }
            };

            cboServer1.SelectedIndexChanged += delegate { loadLeftPaks(); };
            cboServer2.SelectedIndexChanged += delegate { loadRightPaks(); };

            loadLeftPaks();
            loadRightPaks();

            Button btnExecuteMerge = new Button
            {
                Text = "Execute Merge/Create New Server",
                Location = new Point(15, 450),
                Width = 670,
                Height = 36,
                FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
                Anchor = AnchorStyles.Bottom | AnchorStyles.Left | AnchorStyles.Right,
                Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 9.5f, FontStyle.Bold)
            };

            btnExecuteMerge.Click += delegate
            {
                string newServerName = Interaction.InputBox("Enter name for the new merged server folder:", "New Server Name", "MergedServer");
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newServerName)) return;

                string trimmedName = newServerName.Trim();
                if (trimmedName.Equals("Backup_Vanilla", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    trimmedName.Equals("Backup_Saves", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    trimmedName.Equals("Backup_CharacterSaves", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("That name is reserved for system backups.", "Invalid Name", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
                    return;
                }

                string newServerDirPath = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, trimmedName);
                if (Directory.Exists(newServerDirPath))
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("A server folder with that name already exists.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                    return;
                }

                try
                {
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(newServerDirPath);
                    Dictionary<string, string> uniqueMods = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

                    string s1Dir = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, cboServer1.SelectedItem.ToString());
                    foreach (var item in chkListLeft.CheckedItems)
                    {
                        string fileName = item.ToString();
                        string sourcePath = Path.Combine(s1Dir, fileName);
                        string baseName = ExtractBaseModName(fileName);

                        if (uniqueMods.ContainsKey(baseName))
                        {
                            string existingPath = uniqueMods[baseName];
                            DateTime existingDate = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(existingPath);
                            DateTime incomingDate = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(sourcePath);
                            if (incomingDate > existingDate)
                            {
                                uniqueMods[baseName] = sourcePath;
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            uniqueMods[baseName] = sourcePath;
                        }
                    }

                    string s2Dir = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, cboServer2.SelectedItem.ToString());
                    foreach (var item in chkListRight.CheckedItems)
                    {
                        string fileName = item.ToString();
                        string sourcePath = Path.Combine(s2Dir, fileName);
                        string baseName = ExtractBaseModName(fileName);

                        if (uniqueMods.ContainsKey(baseName))
                        {
                            string existingPath = uniqueMods[baseName];
                            DateTime existingDate = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(existingPath);
                            DateTime incomingDate = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(sourcePath);
                            if (incomingDate > existingDate)
                            {
                                uniqueMods[baseName] = sourcePath;
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            uniqueMods[baseName] = sourcePath;
                        }
                    }

                    int copiedCount = 0;
                    foreach (var kvp in uniqueMods)
                    {
                        string src = kvp.Value;
                        string dest = Path.Combine(newServerDirPath, Path.GetFileName(src));
                        File.Copy(src, dest, true);
                        copiedCount++;
                    }

                    RefreshServerList();
                    cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem = trimmedName;
                    mergeForm.Close();
                    MessageBox.Show("Successfully created merged server '" + trimmedName + "' with " + copiedCount + " unique/updated mod(s).", "Merge Complete", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    ShowError("Merging Server Mods", ex);
                }
            };

            mergeForm.Controls.Add(lblServer1);
            mergeForm.Controls.Add(cboServer1);
            mergeForm.Controls.Add(lblServer2);
            mergeForm.Controls.Add(cboServer2);
            mergeForm.Controls.Add(chkListLeft);
            mergeForm.Controls.Add(chkListRight);
            mergeForm.Controls.Add(btnExecuteMerge);

            mergeForm.ShowDialog(this);
        }

        private string ExtractBaseModName(string filename)
        {
            string name = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(filename);

            if (name.EndsWith("_P", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                name = name.Substring(0, name.Length - 2);
            }

            name = Regex.Replace(name, @"^[zZ]+_?", "", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
            name = Regex.Replace(name, @"[_\-\.]?v?\d+[\d\.\-T_r]*$", "", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);

            return name.ToLower().Trim();
        }

        private bool IsReadmeFile(string fileName)
        {
            string fileNameOnly = Path.GetFileName(fileName);
            return Regex.IsMatch(fileNameOnly, @"^.*read.*m*e*.*\.(txt|md|rtf|log)$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase) || 
                   Regex.IsMatch(fileNameOnly, @"^readme.*$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
        }

        private void OnPanelDragEnter(object sender, DragEventArgs e)
        {
            e.Effect = e.Data.GetDataPresent(DataFormats.FileDrop) ? DragDropEffects.Copy : DragDropEffects.None;
        }

        private void OnPanelDragDrop(object sender, DragEventArgs e)
        {
            string[] paths = (string[])e.Data.GetData(DataFormats.FileDrop);
            string serverName = (cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem != null) ? cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem.ToString() : null;

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(serverName))
            {
                serverName = Interaction.InputBox("Enter target server name for these files:", "New Server", "");
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(serverName)) return;

                try
                {
                    string trimmedName = serverName.Trim();
                    if (trimmedName.Equals("Backup_Vanilla", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                        trimmedName.Equals("Backup_Saves", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                        trimmedName.Equals("Backup_CharacterSaves", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        MessageBox.Show("That name is reserved for system backups.", "Invalid Name", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
                        return;
                    }

                    Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, trimmedName));
                    txtServerSearchBox.Text = "";
                    RefreshServerList();
                    cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem = trimmedName;
                    serverName = trimmedName;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    ShowError("Creating Target Server Directory", ex);
                    return;
                }
            }

            string targetServerPath = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, serverName);
            int processedCount = 0;
            string tempExtractDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "MotorTownModManager_" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));

            try
            {
                List<string> filesToProcess = new List<string>();

                foreach (string path in paths)
                {
                    if (File.Exists(path))
                    {
                        string fileName = Path.GetFileName(path);
                        string ext = Path.GetExtension(path);

                        if (ext.Equals(".pak", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            filesToProcess.Add(path);
                        }
                        else if (IsReadmeFile(fileName))
                        {
                            try
                            {
                                ShowReadmeWindow(fileName, File.ReadAllText(path));
                            }
                            catch (Exception ex)
                            {
                                ShowError("Reading Loose Readme File '" + fileName + "'", ex);
                            }
                        }
                        else if (ext.Equals(".zip", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            try
                            {
                                Directory.CreateDirectory(tempExtractDir);
                                ZipFile.ExtractToDirectory(path, tempExtractDir);

                                foreach (string extractedFile in Directory.GetFiles(tempExtractDir, "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
                                {
                                    if (IsReadmeFile(Path.GetFileName(extractedFile)))
                                    {
                                        ShowReadmeWindow(Path.GetFileName(extractedFile), File.ReadAllText(extractedFile));
                                    }
                                }

                                if (chkAutoEngineIni.Checked)
                                {
                                    foreach (string extractedFile in Directory.GetFiles(tempExtractDir, "Engine.ini", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
                                    {
                                        ProcessEngineIni(extractedFile);
                                    }
                                }

                                foreach (string extractedPak in Directory.GetFiles(tempExtractDir, "*.pak", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
                                {
                                    filesToProcess.Add(extractedPak);
                                }
                            }
                            catch (Exception ex)
                            {
                                ShowError("Extracting Zip Archive '" + Path.GetFileName(path) + "'", ex);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                foreach (string file in filesToProcess)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        string incomingFileName = Path.GetFileName(file);

                        if (incomingFileName.Equals("MotorTown-Windows.pak", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            continue;
                        }

                        if (!chkSmartMatching.Checked)
                        {
                            File.Copy(file, Path.Combine(targetServerPath, incomingFileName), true);
                            processedCount++;
                            continue;
                        }

                        string incomingBaseName = ExtractBaseModName(incomingFileName);
                        string[] existingFiles = Directory.GetFiles(targetServerPath, "*.pak");
                        string matchPath = null;

                        foreach (string existing in existingFiles)
                        {
                            if (ExtractBaseModName(Path.GetFileName(existing)) == incomingBaseName)
                            {
                                matchPath = existing;
                                break;
                            }
                        }

                        if (matchPath != null)
                        {
                            string existingFileName = Path.GetFileName(matchPath);

                            if (existingFileName.Equals(incomingFileName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                            {
                                File.Copy(file, Path.Combine(targetServerPath, incomingFileName), true);
                                processedCount++;
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                DateTime existingDate = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(matchPath);
                                DateTime incomingDate = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(file);

                                string comparisonNote = incomingDate > existingDate
                                    ? "• NEW file is newer (Modified: " + incomingDate.ToLocalTime() + ")\n  than existing file (Modified: " + existingDate.ToLocalTime() + ")"
                                    : "• NEW file is older or same (Modified: " + incomingDate.ToLocalTime() + ")\n  than existing file (Modified: " + existingDate.ToLocalTime() + ")";

                                string prompt = "Existing version of this mod detected:\n\n" +
                                                "Existing: " + existingFileName + "\n" +
                                                "Incoming: " + incomingFileName + "\n\n" +
                                                "File Properties:\n" + comparisonNote + "\n\n" +
                                                "Replace old version with the new one?";

                                if (MessageBox.Show(prompt, "Version Conflict Detected", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Question) == DialogResult.Yes)
                                {
                                    File.Delete(matchPath);
                                    File.Copy(file, Path.Combine(targetServerPath, incomingFileName), true);
                                    processedCount++;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            File.Copy(file, Path.Combine(targetServerPath, incomingFileName), true);
                            processedCount++;
                        }
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        ShowError("Processing File '" + Path.GetFileName(file) + "'", ex);
                    }
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                try
                {
                    if (Directory.Exists(tempExtractDir))
                        Directory.Delete(tempExtractDir, true);
                }
                catch { }
            }

            LoadSelectedServerPaks();
            MessageBox.Show("Successfully processed " + processedCount + " .pak file(s) for server '" + serverName + "'.", "Success");
        }

        private void ShowReadmeWindow(string title, string content)
        {
            Form readmeForm = new Form
            {
                Text = "Mod Instructions - " + title,
                Width = 500,
                Height = 450,
                StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent,
                MinimizeBox = false,
                MaximizeBox = false
            };

            TextBox txtContent = new TextBox
            {
                Multiline = true,
                ReadOnly = true,
                ScrollBars = ScrollBars.Vertical,
                Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
                Text = content,
                Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericMonospace, 9.5f)
            };

            Button btnOk = new Button
            {
                Text = "OK (Press Enter)",
                Dock = DockStyle.Bottom,
                Height = 35,
                DialogResult = DialogResult.OK
            };
            btnOk.Click += delegate(object s, EventArgs e) { readmeForm.Close(); };

            readmeForm.Controls.Add(txtContent);
            readmeForm.Controls.Add(btnOk);
            readmeForm.AcceptButton = btnOk;

            readmeForm.ShowDialog(this);
        }

        private void ProcessEngineIni(string newIniPath)
        {
            try
            {
                string targetEngineIniPath;
                if (!EnsureEngineIniExists(out targetEngineIniPath))
                {
                    return;
                }

                string targetIniDir = Path.GetDirectoryName(targetEngineIniPath);
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(targetIniDir) && !Directory.Exists(targetIniDir))
                {
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(targetIniDir);
                }

                if (File.Exists(targetEngineIniPath))
                {
                    File.SetAttributes(targetEngineIniPath, FileAttributes.Normal);
                }

                Dictionary<string, string> existingSettings = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                List<string> existingLines = new List<string>();

                if (File.Exists(targetEngineIniPath))
                {
                    existingLines = new List<string>(File.ReadAllLines(targetEngineIniPath));
                    foreach (string line in existingLines)
                    {
                        string trimmed = line.Trim();
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(trimmed) && !trimmed.StartsWith(";") && !trimmed.StartsWith("#") && trimmed.Contains("="))
                        {
                            int idx = trimmed.IndexOf('=');
                            string key = trimmed.Substring(0, idx).Trim();
                            string val = trimmed.Substring(idx + 1).Trim();
                            existingSettings[key] = val;
                        }
                    }
                }

                Dictionary<string, string> incomingSettings = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                List<string> incomingLines = new List<string>(File.ReadAllLines(newIniPath));
                foreach (string line in incomingLines)
                {
                    string trimmed = line.Trim();
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(trimmed) && !trimmed.StartsWith(";") && !trimmed.StartsWith("#") && trimmed.Contains("="))
                    {
                        int idx = trimmed.IndexOf('=');
                        string key = trimmed.Substring(0, idx).Trim();
                        string val = trimmed.Substring(idx + 1).Trim();
                        incomingSettings[key] = val;
                    }
                }

                List<string> mergedLines = new List<string>(existingLines);
                System.Text.StringBuilder comparisonLog = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
                comparisonLog.AppendLine("Engine.ini Smart Merge Analysis:\n");

                foreach (var kvp in incomingSettings)
                {
                    string key = kvp.Key;
                    string incomingValStr = kvp.Value;

                    if (existingSettings.ContainsKey(key))
                    {
                        string existingValStr = existingSettings[key];

                        if (key.IndexOf("winch", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0 || 
                            key.IndexOf("length", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0 ||
                            key.IndexOf("rope", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                        {
                            float incNum, extNum;
                            if (float.TryParse(incomingValStr, out incNum) && float.TryParse(existingValStr, out extNum))
                            {
                                if (incNum > extNum)
                                {
                                    comparisonLog.AppendLine("[WINCH / LENGTH] " + key + ":\n  Existing: " + existingValStr + "\n  Incoming: " + incomingValStr + "\n  -> Updated to larger value (" + incomingValStr + ")\n");
                                    UpdateOrCreateLine(mergedLines, key, incomingValStr);
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    comparisonLog.AppendLine("[WINCH / LENGTH] " + key + ":\n  Existing: " + existingValStr + "\n  Incoming: " + incomingValStr + "\n  -> Kept larger existing value (" + existingValStr + ")\n");
                                }
                                continue;
                            }
                        }

                        if (existingValStr != incomingValStr)
                        {
                            comparisonLog.AppendLine("[MODIFIED] " + key + ":\n  Existing: " + existingValStr + "\n  Incoming: " + incomingValStr + "\n");
                            UpdateOrCreateLine(mergedLines, key, incomingValStr);
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        comparisonLog.AppendLine("[NEW] " + key + " = " + incomingValStr + "\n");
                        mergedLines.Add(key + "=" + incomingValStr);
                    }
                }

                Form diffForm = new Form
                {
                    Text = "Engine.ini Changes Approval",
                    Width = 550,
                    Height = 480,
                    StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent,
                    MinimizeBox = false,
                    MaximizeBox = false
                };

                Label lblHeader = new Label
                {
                    Text = "A mod included an Engine.ini file. Review proposed changes below:",
                    Dock = DockStyle.Top,
                    Height = 25,
                    TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft,
                    Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 9, FontStyle.Bold)
                };

                TextBox txtDiff = new TextBox
                {
                    Multiline = true,
                    ReadOnly = true,
                    ScrollBars = ScrollBars.Vertical,
                    Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
                    Text = comparisonLog.ToString(),
                    Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericMonospace, 9)
                };

                Panel pnlButtons = new Panel { Dock = DockStyle.Bottom, Height = 40 };
                Button btnApprove = new Button { Text = "Approve Edits", DialogResult = DialogResult.Yes, Width = 150, Height = 30, Location = new Point(105, 5) };
                Button btnCancel = new Button { Text = "Skip Edits", DialogResult = DialogResult.No, Width = 150, Height = 30, Location = new Point(285, 5) };

                pnlButtons.Controls.Add(btnApprove);
                pnlButtons.Controls.Add(btnCancel);

                diffForm.Controls.Add(txtDiff);
                diffForm.Controls.Add(lblHeader);
                diffForm.Controls.Add(pnlButtons);
                diffForm.AcceptButton = btnApprove;
                diffForm.CancelButton = btnCancel;

                if (diffForm.ShowDialog(this) == DialogResult.Yes)
                {
                    File.WriteAllLines(targetEngineIniPath, mergedLines);
                    File.SetAttributes(targetEngineIniPath, FileAttributes.ReadOnly);

                    MessageBox.Show("Engine.ini successfully updated, merged, and locked as Read-Only.", "Success", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
                }
                else
                {
                    if (File.Exists(targetEngineIniPath))
                    {
                        File.SetAttributes(targetEngineIniPath, FileAttributes.ReadOnly);
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Processing Engine.ini Configuration", ex);
            }
        }

        private void UpdateOrCreateLine(List<string> lines, string key, string newValue)
        {
            bool found = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < lines.Count; i++)
            {
                string trimmed = lines[i].Trim();
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(trimmed) && !trimmed.StartsWith(";") && trimmed.StartsWith(key, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    int idx = trimmed.IndexOf('=');
                    if (idx != -1 && trimmed.Substring(0, idx).Trim().Equals(key, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        lines[i] = key + "=" + newValue;
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!found)
            {
                lines.Add(key + "=" + newValue);
            }
        }

        private void OnOpenEngineIniClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string targetEngineIniPath;
            if (!EnsureEngineIniExists(out targetEngineIniPath))
            {
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                string targetIniDir = Path.GetDirectoryName(targetEngineIniPath);
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(targetIniDir) && !Directory.Exists(targetIniDir))
                {
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(targetIniDir);
                }

                if (File.Exists(targetEngineIniPath))
                {
                    File.SetAttributes(targetEngineIniPath, FileAttributes.Normal);
                }
                else
                {
                    File.WriteAllText(targetEngineIniPath, "; Motor Town Engine.ini Config\n");
                }

                string selectedEditor = (cboEditorSelector.SelectedItem != null) ? cboEditorSelector.SelectedItem.ToString() : "Windows Notepad";
                
                if (selectedEditor.Equals("Notepad++", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    string nppPath = @"C:\Program Files\Notepad++\notepad++.exe";
                    if (!File.Exists(nppPath)) nppPath = @"C:\Program Files (x86)\Notepad++\notepad++.exe";
                    
                    if (File.Exists(nppPath))
                    {
                        Process.Start(nppPath, "\"" + targetEngineIniPath + "\"");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        MessageBox.Show("Notepad++ executable could not be found in standard paths. Falling back to Windows Notepad.", "Editor Not Found", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
                        Process.Start("notepad.exe", targetEngineIniPath);
                    }
                }
                else if (selectedEditor.Equals("VS Code", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    string codePath = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), @"Programs\Microsoft VS Code\Code.exe");
                    if (!File.Exists(codePath)) codePath = @"C:\Program Files\Microsoft VS Code\Code.exe";

                    if (File.Exists(codePath))
                    {
                        Process.Start(codePath, "\"" + targetEngineIniPath + "\"");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        MessageBox.Show("VS Code executable could not be found in standard paths. Falling back to Windows Notepad.", "Editor Not Found", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
                        Process.Start("notepad.exe", targetEngineIniPath);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    Process.Start("notepad.exe", targetEngineIniPath);
                }
                
                MessageBox.Show("Engine.ini has been unlocked for editing.\n\nClick OK once you are finished editing to lock it back to Read-Only automatically.", "Engine.ini Unlocked", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Opening Engine.ini", ex);
            }
            finally
            {
                try
                {
                    if (File.Exists(targetEngineIniPath))
                    {
                        File.SetAttributes(targetEngineIniPath, FileAttributes.ReadOnly);
                    }
                }
                catch { }
            }
        }

        private void OnDeployModsClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string serverName = (cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem != null) ? cboServerDropdown.SelectedItem.ToString() : null;
            string gamePath = txtGamePath.Text;

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(serverName))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Please select or create a server first.", "Error");
                return;
            }

            if (!Directory.Exists(gamePath))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Target game directory does not exist.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            if (MessageBox.Show("This will clear out existing mod paks in your game folder and deploy '" + serverName + "' mods.\n\nProceed?", "Deploy Mods", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Warning) != DialogResult.Yes)
                return;

            try
            {
                foreach (string pak in Directory.GetFiles(gamePath, "*.pak"))
                {
                    if (!Path.GetFileName(pak).Equals("MotorTown-Windows.pak", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        File.Delete(pak);
                    }
                }

                string sourceDir = Path.Combine(serverStorageDir, serverName);
                int deployedCount = 0;

                foreach (string pak in Directory.GetFiles(sourceDir, "*.pak"))
                {
                    File.Copy(pak, Path.Combine(gamePath, Path.GetFileName(pak)), true);
                    deployedCount++;
                }

                MessageBox.Show("Successfully deployed " + deployedCount + " mod file(s) from server '" + serverName + "'.", "Success");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Deploying Mods to Game Directory", ex);
            }
        }

        private void OnRevertVanillaClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string gamePath = txtGamePath.Text;

            if (!Directory.Exists(gamePath))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Target game directory does not exist.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            if (MessageBox.Show("This will remove all installed mods from your game folder and restore vanilla configuration.\n\nProceed?", "Revert to Vanilla", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Warning) != DialogResult.Yes)
                return;

            try
            {
                int removedCount = 0;
                foreach (string pak in Directory.GetFiles(gamePath, "*.pak"))
                {
                    if (!Path.GetFileName(pak).Equals("MotorTown-Windows.pak", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        File.Delete(pak);
                        removedCount++;
                    }
                }

                MessageBox.Show("Successfully removed " + removedCount + " mod file(s). Game restored to clean vanilla state.", "Success", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Removing Mods from Game Directory", ex);
            }
        }

        private void OnBackupPaksClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string gamePath = txtGamePath.Text;

            if (!Directory.Exists(gamePath))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Target game directory does not exist.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                if (!Directory.Exists(backupStorageDir))
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(backupStorageDir);

                string sourceFile = Path.Combine(gamePath, "MotorTown-Windows.pak");

                if (!File.Exists(sourceFile))
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("Could not find 'MotorTown-Windows.pak' in the target game directory.", "Backup Failed", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                    return;
                }

                string destFile = Path.Combine(backupStorageDir, "MotorTown-Windows.pak");
                File.Copy(sourceFile, destFile, true);

                MessageBox.Show("Successfully backed up 'MotorTown-Windows.pak' to 'ServerMods\\Backup_Vanilla'.", "Backup Complete", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Backing Up Game Pak", ex);
            }
        }

        private void OnRestoreBackupClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string gamePath = txtGamePath.Text;

            if (!Directory.Exists(gamePath))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Target game directory does not exist.", "Error", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            string sourceBackupFile = Path.Combine(backupStorageDir, "MotorTown-Windows.pak");

            if (!File.Exists(sourceBackupFile))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("No backup file found for 'MotorTown-Windows.pak' inside 'ServerMods\\Backup_Vanilla'. Please run 'Backup Main Game File' first.", "No Backup Found", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
                return;
            }

            if (MessageBox.Show("This will overwrite your current game core package ('MotorTown-Windows.pak') with your saved backup version. Proceed?", "Restore Backup", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Warning) != DialogResult.Yes)
                return;

            try
            {
                string destFile = Path.Combine(gamePath, "MotorTown-Windows.pak");
                File.Copy(sourceBackupFile, destFile, true);

                MessageBox.Show("Successfully restored 'MotorTown-Windows.pak' from backup.", "Restore Complete", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Restoring Game Pak from Backup", ex);
            }
        }

        private void OnBackupSavesClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string charactersDir = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), @"MotorTown\Saved\SaveGames\Characters");

            if (!Directory.Exists(charactersDir))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Characters save directory could not be found at:\n" + charactersDir, "Backup Failed", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Error);
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                if (!Directory.Exists(saveGameBackupDir))
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(saveGameBackupDir);

                string[] saveFiles = Directory.GetFiles(charactersDir, "*.sav");
                int backedUpCount = 0;

                foreach (string file in saveFiles)
                {
                    string fileName = Path.GetFileName(file);
                    if (Regex.IsMatch(fileName, @"backup\d+", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase))
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    string destFile = Path.Combine(saveGameBackupDir, fileName);
                    File.Copy(file, destFile, true);
                    backedUpCount++;
                }

                MessageBox.Show("Successfully backed up " + backedUpCount + " character save file(s) to 'ServerMods\\Backup_Saves'.", "Backup Complete", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Backing Up Character Saves", ex);
            }
        }

        private void OnManageSavesClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            string charactersLiveDir = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), @"MotorTown\Saved\SaveGames\Characters");
            
            if (!Directory.Exists(saveGameBackupDir) || Directory.GetFiles(saveGameBackupDir, "*.sav").Length == 0)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("No saved character backups found in 'ServerMods\\Backup_Saves'. Please run 'Backup Character Saves' first.", "No Saves Backed Up", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
                return;
            }

            Form manageForm = new Form
            {
                Text = "Manage / Restore Character Saves",
                Width = 480,
                Height = 460,
                StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent,
                MinimizeBox = false,
                MaximizeBox = false
            };

            Label lblInfo = new Label
            {
                Text = "Select character saves to restore to game\nor delete from backup storage:",
                Location = new Point(15, 15),
                AutoSize = false,
                Size = new Size(435, 40),
                Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 9, FontStyle.Bold),
                Anchor = AnchorStyles.Top | AnchorStyles.Left | AnchorStyles.Right
            };

            CheckedListBox chkListSaves = new CheckedListBox
            {
                Location = new Point(15, 60),
                Size = new Size(435, 285),
                CheckOnClick = true,
                Anchor = AnchorStyles.Top | AnchorStyles.Bottom | AnchorStyles.Left | AnchorStyles.Right
            };

            foreach (string file in Directory.GetFiles(saveGameBackupDir, "*.sav"))
            {
                string fileName = Path.GetFileName(file);
                chkListSaves.Items.Add(fileName, true);
            }

            Button btnRestoreSelected = new Button
            {
                Text = "Restore Selected Saves",
                Location = new Point(15, 355),
                Width = 215,
                Height = 38,
                FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
                Anchor = AnchorStyles.Bottom | AnchorStyles.Left,
                Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 8.5f, FontStyle.Bold)
            };

            Button btnDeleteSelectedSaves = new Button
            {
                Text = "Delete Selected Saves",
                Location = new Point(238, 355),
                Width = 215,
                Height = 38,
                FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
                Anchor = AnchorStyles.Bottom | AnchorStyles.Right,
                Font = new Font(FontFamily.GenericSansSerif, 8.5f, FontStyle.Bold)
            };

            btnRestoreSelected.Click += delegate
            {
                if (chkListSaves.CheckedItems.Count == 0)
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("Please check at least one save file to restore.", "Notice");
                    return;
                }

                if (!Directory.Exists(charactersLiveDir))
                {
                    try { Directory.CreateDirectory(charactersLiveDir); }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        ShowError("Creating Live Characters Directory", ex);
                        return;
                    }
                }

                if (MessageBox.Show("Are you sure you want to restore the selected character save(s) to your active game files?", "Confirm Restore", MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Warning) != DialogResult.Yes)
                    return;

                try
                {
                    int restored = 0;
                    foreach (var item in chkListSaves.CheckedItems)
                    {
                        string fileName = item.ToString();
                        string src = Path.Combine(saveGameBackupDir, fileName);
                        string dest = Path.Combine(charactersLiveDir, fileName);
                        File.Copy(src, dest, true);
                        restored++;
                    }

                    MessageBox.Show("Successfully restored " + restored + " character save file(s) to the game directory.", "Restore Complete", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    ShowError("Restoring Character Saves", ex);
                }
            };

            btnDeleteSelectedSaves.Click += delegate
            {
                if (chkListSaves.CheckedItems.Count == 0)
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("Please check at least one save file to delete.", "Notice");
                    return;
                }

                string confirmationInput = Interaction.InputBox("To permanently delete the selected save backup(s), type 'delete' below:", "Confirm Deletion", "");
                if (!confirmationInput.Trim().Equals("delete", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("Deletion cancelled. You must type 'delete' correctly to confirm.", "Cancelled", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
                    return;
                }

                try
                {
                    int deleted = 0;
                    List<object> itemsToRemove = new List<object>();
                    foreach (var item in chkListSaves.CheckedItems)
                    {
                        string fileName = item.ToString();
                        string targetPath = Path.Combine(saveGameBackupDir, fileName);
                        if (File.Exists(targetPath))
                        {
                            File.Delete(targetPath);
                            deleted++;
                            itemsToRemove.Add(item);
                        }
                    }

                    foreach (var item in itemsToRemove)
                    {
                        chkListSaves.Items.Remove(item);
                    }

                    MessageBox.Show("Successfully deleted " + deleted + " save backup file(s).", "Deleted", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    ShowError("Deleting Character Saves", ex);
                }
            };

            manageForm.Controls.Add(lblInfo);
            manageForm.Controls.Add(chkListSaves);
            manageForm.Controls.Add(btnRestoreSelected);
            manageForm.Controls.Add(btnDeleteSelectedSaves);

            manageForm.ShowDialog(this);
        }

        private void OnLaunchGameClicked(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                Process.Start("steam://rungameid/1369670");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Launch Motor Town via Steam", ex);
            }
        }
    }

& $cscPath /target:winexe /out:ModManager.exe /r:System.dll /r:System.Drawing.dll /r:System.Windows.Forms.dll /r:System.IO.Compression.FileSystem.dll /r:Microsoft.VisualBasic.dll ModManager.cs
